fields.name: Entities
fields.evidence: NoesisGameUI.dll+0x462DD0 (VMItemRegistrationSystem::Update): the singleton view's first pointer is cleared when its key count (+0x2C) is non-zero, and after VMItemDataSingletonComponent::CreateVM(entity) the entity is inserted with FUN_1800f88d0 (the same EntityHandle hash insert used by the Data maps); bg3.exe+0x1299840 allocates 0x30 and zeroes it as a HashSet; destructor thunk_FUN_140582ad0 frees three arrays (trivial 8-byte keys). HashSet = StaticArray<int32> buckets +0, Array<int32> NextIds +0x10, Array<key> Keys +0x20; live samples: bucket count at +8, cap/size pairs at +0x18/+0x28. Samples always show an empty key array (size 0), consistent with a per-frame 'newly registered' set.

summary: Client UI registry: the item entities whose view-model was created in this frame (the set is cleared at the start of each update, then filled after CreateVM). Singleton, lives from game start.
